exposure: prolonged second stage of labor (>3 hours)
cohort: The study included 3643 nulliparous women, aged >=18 years, with cephalic presentation and a gestational age of >=24 weeks, who had epidural anesthesia and a vaginal delivery at a tertiary maternity hospital in China.
finding: The study found no significant difference in the risk of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) associated with a second stage of labor lasting >3 hours compared to <=3 hours in the studied population.
